label: copy phase, fed-back input f/r/g/i early-to-mid in the copy
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (never in the original phase or on the delimiter, never at recall_idx 0). It is concentrated on steps whose fed-back input is f, r, g or i (about 86% of activation mass; s, x and n are weaker). It is strongest early-to-mid in the copy (recall_idx 2-3, absolute t 10-12) and in long sequences (L=9 holds 59% of mass). Weak preference for output tokens r/s. Precision is low: most f/r/g/i copy steps do not activate, and adding L>=8 only raises precision to about 0.34. The remaining selectivity was not captured by any simple variable I tried.
